build_feature_extractor: build a DINOv2 feature extractor by calling make_feature_extractor with a dinov2 model name string
create_grid_points: create a regular 2D grid of center coordinates using generate_grid_points with grid size and cell size
filter_points_by_box: filter 2D point coordinates to keep only those inside a bounding box using filter_points_by_box
filter_points_by_mask: filter 2D point coordinates to keep only those inside a binary mask using filter_points_by_mask
sample_feature_map: sample feature vectors from a feature map at specified 2D coordinates using sample_feature_map_at_points
